string.text: Word is a mass mutant migration is coming — everyone agreed on a ceasefire to restock and keep the beasts from spreading. Shame nobody warned the scorpion-boys and the monochromes. [Ceasefire, mutant migration, injectors offline]
Hunting Season: mutant injectors are useless right now.
Sidorovich, we are taking the contract.
Stalkers! To keep the ceasefire, I put a 500,000 bounty on the violator's head. Good luck, you deficient bastard.
ATTENTION. A ceasefire is in effect. Attempts to kill for the purpose of looting will be punished by death.
Have you completely lost it, you woodpecker? Want nobody to ever make a deal again? After stunts like that nobody will want to work with you, and your reputation will take a hard hit.
